name: Ardimento, A.A., Briganti, Perelli v Italy (ILVA)

jurisdiction.court: European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) - First Section

description: Four twin judgments (applications nos. 4642/17 Ardimento and Others, 37277/16 A.A. and Others, 48820/19 Briganti and Others, 45242/17 Perelli and Others) brought by further citizens of Taranto and neighbouring municipalities against Italy over the continuing pollution from the emissions of the former Ilva plant, following the Cordella judgment of 2019.
outcome: Violation of Articles 8 and 13 ECHR confirmed. The Court found that, years after the Cordella judgment, the situation of serious pollution persists, as does the impasse of the Italian authorities in handling the environmental issue, with danger to the health of the population. The urgency of adopting the remediation measures provided for in the environmental plan was reiterated.
